name: Koreth
beschreibung: Hotel Koreth is located in the municipality of Kirchdorf in Tirol, nestled in the alpine landscape of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The surroundings are characterized by extensive forests and mountain meadows, ensuring a quiet and nature-oriented location. The hotel's amenities include comfortable rooms with balcony, a wellness area with sauna and steam bath, and a restaurant serving Austrian cuisine. The atmosphere at the hotel is simple and focused on relaxation, without excessive luxury. The target group is primarily hikers and winter sports enthusiasts looking for a practical starting point for activities in the region. Couples and small groups will also find practical accommodation here for an active vacation.
